brief.headline: Hold price at or below ₹0.80/pc (top of market-fair band) and test faster payment for a 1–2% cut

priceAsk.summary: Ask Rachana to hold current pricing and confirm it sits at or below ₹0.80/pc for our cap specification; if above, negotiate down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc (upper end of market-fair band with volume headroom)
priceAsk.basis: Market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — we spend ₹44.37 L annually, so volume justifies the lower band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days earlier (cut to 15 days after receipt) in exchange for a 1–2% price reduction
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier costs us ₹1.82 L in cash, so the trade must save us at least that much annually to break even

brief.financialLeverage: Rachana Plastics is a private supplier with no public financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our ₹44.37 L spend is meaningful for a packaging converter of this profile. With five strong alternates already identified — including Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr, health B) and Mold-Tek (₹946.50 Cr, listed, health B) — we have real fallback options, which gives us room to push on price and terms without risking supply. The market shows modest headroom, so a firm but fair ask is credible.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with Rachana is ₹44.37 L
Market asking price for 28 mm PP cap sits in a ₹0.55–1.20/pc band, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict: MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
We currently pay 30 days after receipt; moving to 15 days costs us ₹1.82 L in working cash
HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg, giving a raw-material reference

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private, health B, ₹2569.83 Cr)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter covering pharma bottles, caps and preforms — top second-source candidate with scale and strong health

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed, health B, ₹946.50 Cr)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader in pails, containers and pharma packaging — profitable and robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (Manufacturer, India-Pan) — a lead to qualify
alternates.why: Resin maker with pan-India reach; medium-confidence lead from market research — verify capability and willingness to supply finished caps before RFQ

risks: Rachana publishes no financials, so we fly blind on their cash health and stability — mitigate by qualifying Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a live second source now
If we push too hard on price without a backup qualified, Rachana may walk and leave us scrambling — line up at least one alternate quote before the meeting
Paying 15 days earlier (₹1.82 L cash cost) only makes sense if the price cut saves us more than that annually — do the math before offering the trade
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are research leads, not qualified suppliers — treat them as long-term pipeline, not immediate fallbacks
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹44.37 L a year with you on rigid packaging, and we want to keep that business here — but we need to see pricing at or below ₹0.80 per piece to stay competitive with the market and justify sole-sourcing from Rachana.
